{{recipesummary|category=Southwestern recipes
| Yield = 8 tacos|servings=4|difficulty=2
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southwestern cuisine|Southwestern Cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Chilli Powder|chilli powder]]
*1½ tablespoons [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
*½ tablespoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*2 cloves [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
*1 dash [[Cookbook:Red Pepper|red pepper]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef substitute]] (e.g. MorningStar Farms Grillers Recipe Crumbles)
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*8 [[Cookbook:Tortilla|flour tortillas]]

=== Suggested toppings ===
*1 can [[Cookbook:Refried Beans|refried beans]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]], chopped
*1 cup chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*2 cups shredded [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]]
*1 cup shredded Colby-Jack [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]] (or [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar]])
*[[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]

==Procedure==
#In a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] brown onions on medium-low heat.
#Add garlic, chilli powder, paprika, salt, and red pepper. Stir and cook for 1 minute.
#Add beef substitute and water. Cook for 10–15 minutes until most of the water is gone.
#Meanwhile [[Cookbook:Chopping|chop]] and shred the toppings as needed. Put toppings in bowls on table.
#Start to warm refried beans in a small pot.
#Heat another [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] on medium-low heat.
#Put vegetarian taco meat and refried beans in bowls and place on table.
#Put floured tortilla in pan and lightly brown both sides. As tortillas are ready allow guests to select their own toppings.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The filling and refried beans keep well in the refrigerator.
